title: ASSEMBLY OF PARKING BRAKE AND SHIM REPLACEMENT

content.description: Two illustrations showing hand positions for shim installation or adjustment on brake components

items: (a) Remove the parking brake lever, and install the correct size shim.
(b) Install the parking brake lever with a new C-washer.
